create_function_datetime_: create a datetime expression from year, month, day components with optional hour, minute, second, microsecond and timezone
build_function_duration: build a duration expression from weeks, days, hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds, microseconds, and nanoseconds components
create_function_concat_list: create a single list column by horizontally concatenating multiple columns into one list
create_function_struct: create a struct column by collecting multiple columns or expressions into a single struct field
create_function_concat_str: create a single string column by horizontally concatenating multiple columns with a separator
